name: Zombie Walk
steps: Give the teddy bear on the floor to the nurse.
Give the pacifier to the nurse.
Give the diaper from the cart to the nurse.
Give the white coat on the wall to the nurse.
Place the baby in the incubator.
Tap the button on the door to open the hallway view.
Give the snack to the person hiding on the bed.
Place the wind-up key on the toy monkey.
Tap the alarm button on the wall to distract the zombies and complete the level.
